responsibility: Small C-side glue layer through which the language-independent Go frontend queries GCC backend properties and exchanges Go-specific object-file metadata. It exposes helpers to test whether GCC has already issued errors, compute backend-controlled struct-field alignment, and disable strict-aliasing assumptions when the Go `unsafe` package is imported, and it owns writing and reading the Go export-data payload in the target object file’s dedicated section/segment using GCC section APIs and `simple-object` readers.
